title: Assemble the exact frozen v1.0 candidate set
description:
One attested candidate-root artifact authenticates and indexes every exact producer artifact for promotion into durable candidate escrow.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Using exact producer artifact IDs, assembly fetches API/run metadata and downloads each by ID with read-only permissions; it requires non-expiry through day 60, exact artifact ZIP/subject digests, schema, candidate tag/freeze SHA, repository/workflow path+SHA/run+attempt/actor/event identity, and valid attestations. Derived-name listings must agree but never select authority; foreign, expired, mismatched, or rebuilt supplied evidence fails, while unselected rerun artifacts are ignored.
- [hard] REQ-02: The root records exact freeze-root, candidate-handoff, and push-owned candidate-event completed/recovery IDs/digests passed through same-run outputs; validation evidence; every producer ID/digest/expiry/subject; native/source/SPDX/attestations; MCP integrity/provenance; OCI identities; docs/release metadata; and protocol versions. No value is inferred or substituted.
- [hard] REQ-03: Assembly attests the root-manifest file, uploads it once as `candidate-root-<candidate-tag>-<SHA>-run<R>-attempt<A>` with overwrite false and 90-day retention, and records its REST artifact ID/digest/expiry. Candidate escrow accepts that exact ID; every later envelope names this root plus its immediate transition parents rather than discovering future records from root/name/latest-success.
- [hard] REQ-04: The complete set is content-addressed and immutable; no producer/assembly job modifies source or public state. Missing retention, failed root upload/attestation, later source change, or replacement prevents escrow and requires attested abandonment plus a new source freeze/candidate.

## Notes

Blast radius: read-only producer verification plus one attested candidate-root artifact; public escrow is a separate dependent leaf.
